anchors.title: Eastern Beach Reserve & Carousel
anchors.description: Geelong's heritage Art Deco waterfront — sea baths, 1930s diving boards, the restored 1892 carousel and the famous painted Baywalk Bollards stretching along the foreshore.

anchors.title: National Wool Museum
anchors.description: Bluestone 1872 wool store on the waterfront, now home to Australia's national wool museum. See the working 1910 Axminster carpet loom and trace the industry that built the city.

anchors.title: Geelong Botanic Gardens
anchors.description: Free 19th-century gardens on Eastern Park, with the 21st Century Garden (a dryland exhibition), the Tropical Glasshouse and the heritage Director's Cottage cafe.

anchors.title: Steampacket Place & Cunningham Pier
anchors.description: Refurbished bayside dining precinct and the city's iconic pier, with the popular The Pier restaurant at its far end. Bay walking trails and ferry connections to Portarlington.

anchors.title: Bellarine Peninsula Day Trip
anchors.description: 30 minutes east — Queenscliff's heritage main street, the Bellarine Railway steam tours, and the cellar doors of Jack Rabbit, Scotchmans Hill and Terindah Estate.

SUNDAY.title: Geelong Showgrounds Farmers Market
SUNDAY.description: Second Saturday of each month, 9am-1pm. 40+ regional growers, fresh produce, breakfast carts and live music at the Geelong Showgrounds.
